description: Actual production native analysis of five Wikimedia exercise clips and original generated 120 BPM PCM music; source videos excluded. See docs/GYM_ACCEPTANCE.md for attribution.

frames.description: Uncertain scene; closest visual match: bench press
Uncertain scene; closest visual match: bench press
Uncertain scene; closest visual match: squat

vision.method: MobileCLIP-S0 fp32 image / quantized text, 512-D normalized embeddings; candidate cosine similarity and relative softmax (temperature 0.02). YOLOX Nano COCO detections, confidence ≥0.30, NMS 0.45. Three representative frames per sampled scene.
limitations: Relative label confidence is not a calibrated probability; uncertain exercise labels require review.
No face detector, pose/rep phase detector, identity recognition or reliable camera-shake estimator is installed.
Subject is the largest confidence-weighted detected person in each sample; this is sparse position evidence, not continuous identity tracking.
At most 32 evenly distributed scenes / 96 frames per asset; unsampled ranges have no semantic evidence.

video.method: FFmpeg scene scores > 0.30 on every frame at 160×90; luma, Laplacian variance and frame differences sampled at 2 Hz (96×54). No artistic-quality or exercise classifier.
